## 🎯 Reading Paths

### For First-Time Users (10 minutes)

```
1. START-HERE.md              (2 min)
2. Run setup.bat              (5 min)
3. Review PROJECT-SETUP-SUMMARY.md (auto-generated)
4. Keep QUICK-REFERENCE.md handy
5. Start using agents!
```

### For Team Leads (30 minutes)

```
1. START-HERE.md              (2 min)
2. README.md                  (10 min)
3. AGENT-REFERENCE.md         (15 min)
4. Run setup.bat              (5 min)
5. Review generated configuration
```

### For Architects (60 minutes)

```
1. README.md                  (10 min)
2. SIMPLIFICATION-SUMMARY.md  (15 min)
3. AGENT-REFERENCE.md         (20 min)
4. ADVANCED-USAGE.md          (20 min)
5. Review template files
```

### When You Have Problems

```
1. QUICK-REFERENCE.md → Quick fixes section
2. TROUBLESHOOTING.md → Detailed solutions
3. PROJECT-SETUP-SUMMARY.md → Your configuration
4. AGENT-REFERENCE.md → Agent-specific help
```

### For Customization

```
1. INSTALLATION-GUIDE.md → Manual setup process
2. ADVANCED-USAGE.md → Custom configuration
3. Template files → Placeholder reference
4. setup.ps1 → See what it automates
```

## 📝 Notes

### For Maintainers

When updating documentation:
1. Update version numbers in all files
2. Update "Last Updated" dates
3. Regenerate this INDEX.md
4. Test all links
5. Verify code examples

### For Contributors

New documentation should:
- Follow markdown best practices
- Include table of contents for long docs
- Use consistent formatting
- Add to this index
- Update START-HERE.md if entry point changes

### For Distributors

Minimum files to include:
1. START-HERE.md
2. setup.bat + setup.ps1
3. README.md
4. QUICK-REFERENCE.md
5. docs/ folder (all reference)
6. prompts/ folder (all templates)
7. instructions/ folder (all templates)

Optional but recommended:
- INSTALLATION-GUIDE.md
- All analysis documents in docs/
